posts.title: Finding four corners when all the maps are wrong
posts.description: The Four Corners is often thought of as where Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, and Arizona collide. But if you are satisfied with a municipal as opposed to an interstate four corners, you likely can find a quadripoint much closer to home. posts.title: Mapping the Long Trail: the best is now free with OpenStreetMaps
posts.description: On January 24, 2010, Zeke Farwell completed the Long Trail. He had begun just two days earlier, connecting more than 50 segments of trail spanning over 200 miles. Motivated by “the longest and most well known hiking trail in Vermont”, Zeke often revisited portions of the trails in the years to come.
